card.name: Graphite
card.summary_zh: 在线绘制和编辑矢量、栅格图形的开源创作工具。
field_notes: 运行平台尚未核定，留空

zh:
> 译注：原文 Reddit 社区链接在本次检查中返回 HTTP 403；可使用原文提供的 [官方 Discord 社区](https://discord.graphite.art/)。 # 用于二维内容创作的程序化工具箱 **Graphite 是一款免费开源的矢量与栅格图形引擎，现已提供 [Alpha 版本](https://editor.graphite.art)。使用完全无损的编辑工作流，将基于图层的合成与基于节点的生成式设计结合起来，发挥创意。** Graphite 最初是一款矢量编辑器，目前正不断发展为通用的一体化图形工具箱，其构造更像游戏引擎，而非常规创意应用。编辑器工具围绕节点图核心构建，为矢量、栅格及其他内容提供易用的工作流。照片编辑、动态图形、数字绘画、桌面排版和视觉特效合成是[路线图](https://graphite.art/features/#roadmap)中计划增加的能力，目标是让 Graphite 成为用途广泛的内容创作工具。 在[网站](https://graphite.art/),了解更多，订阅[通讯](https://graphite.art/#newsletter),考虑[参与志愿工作](https://graphite.art/volunteer/)或[捐赠](https://graphite.art/donate/),，别忘了给这个仓库一颗 ⭐！
                   

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f4604aea-e8f1-45ce-9218-46ddc666f11d ## 支持我们的使命 ❤️ Graphite 完全由社区构建并资助。如果认同我们的**使命**，欢迎通过[捐赠](https://graphite.art/donate/)帮助项目持续发展： > Graphite 努力打造所有人都能使用的最佳综合艺术与设计工具，释放每一位新晋艺术家和资深专业人士的创造力。 > > 当 Graphite 成为行业标准时，这一使命才算成功。一致的产品愿景以及重创新、轻模仿的策略将使这一目标成为可能。 ## 截图 ![使用无损布尔运算和程序化圆点图案制作](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/decb7011-18c2-4c68-82af-d1fa5064244a) ![填充噪声图案的 Mandelbrot 分形，由程序生成且可无限缩放](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9e023997-185b-4f43-a724-797d308d9e7b) ![杂志跨页设计，预览未来对桌面排版的关注](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/90eca551-5868-4f8d-9016-33958bf96345) ## 贡献与构建代码 你是图形程序员或 Rust 开发者吗？Graphite 致力于成为在开源世界运用工程技能时最容易上手的项目之一。请参阅[这里的说明](https://graphite.art/volunteer/guide/)，了解如何配置项目并开始开发。 ## 许可证 除非仓库中另有说明，Graphite 源代码采用双许可，你可以选择 [MIT 许可证](https://github.com/GraphiteEditor/Graphite/blob/8206b4cc8810d357852b3bb4d669d3efd02d41ca/LICENSE-MIT)或 [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/GraphiteEditor/Graphite/blob/8206b4cc8810d357852b3bb4d669d3efd02d41ca/LICENSE-APACHE),。向项目提交代码即表示你同意以两种许可证授权你的贡献，并有权这样做。
en:
# Your procedural toolbox for 2D content creation **Graphite is a free, open source vector and raster graphics engine, [available now](https://editor.graphite.art) in alpha. Get creative with a fully nondestructive editing workflow that combines layer-based compositing with node-based generative design.** Having begun life as a vector editor, Graphite continues evolving into a generalized, all-in-one graphics toolbox that's built more like a game engine than a conventional creative app. The editor's tools wrap its node graph core, providing user-friendly workflows for vector, raster, and beyond. Photo editing, motion graphics, digital painting, desktop publishing, and VFX compositing are additional competencies on the planned [roadmap](https://graphite.art/features/#roadmap) making Graphite into a highly versatile content creation tool. Learn more from the [website](https://graphite.art/), subscribe to the [newsletter](https://graphite.art/#newsletter), consider [volunteering](https://graphite.art/volunteer/) or [donating](https://graphite.art/donate/), and remember to give this repository a ⭐!
                   

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f4604aea-e8f1-45ce-9218-46ddc666f11d ## Support our mission ❤️ Graphite is 100% community built and funded. Please become a part of keeping the project alive and thriving with a [donation](https://graphite.art/donate/) if you share a belief in our **mission**: > Graphite strives to unshackle the creativity of every budding artist and seasoned professional by building the best comprehensive art and design tool that's accessible to all. > > Mission success will come when Graphite is an industry standard. A cohesive product vision and focus on innovation over imitation is the strategy that will make that possible. ## Screenshots ![Made using nondestructive boolean operations and procedural polka dot patterns](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/decb7011-18c2-4c68-82af-d1fa5064244a) ![Mandelbrot fractal filled with a noise pattern, procedurally generated and infinitely scalable](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9e023997-185b-4f43-a724-797d308d9e7b) ![Design for a magazine spread, a preview of the upcoming focus on desktop publishing](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/90eca551-5868-4f8d-9016-33958bf96345) ## Contributing/building the code Are you a graphics programmer or Rust developer? Graphite aims to be one of the most approachable projects for putting your engineering skills to use in the world of open source. See [instructions here](https://graphite.art/volunteer/guide/) for setting up the project and getting started. ## License Graphite's source code is dual-licensed under your choice of either the [MIT license](https://github.com/GraphiteEditor/Graphite/blob/8206b4cc8810d357852b3bb4d669d3efd02d41ca/LICENSE-MIT) or the [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/GraphiteEditor/Graphite/blob/8206b4cc8810d357852b3bb4d669d3efd02d41ca/LICENSE-APACHE), at your option, unless otherwise noted within the repository. By submitting code for inclusion in the project, you agree to license your contributions under both licenses, and that you have the authority to do so.
